questTitle: Run a Half Marathon on my 39th bday
statusStatement: Another interval-training session was reported, supporting the interval component of the intended weekly routine. This week's long run and two-run target are not established.
whatMattersNow: Establish the long-run component alongside the interval run in the weekly routine.
outcomeStatement: I will run a half marathon on 20 November 2026, my 39th birthday, while sustaining two weekly runs: one long run and one interval run.
quote: Success is the sum of small efforts, repeated day in and day out.

statusStatement: The fence was previously recorded as complete, and a driveway quote was requested. Receipt or acceptance of the quote, driveway construction, gate installation, overkapping, and carport ground completion are unconfirmed.
whatMattersNow: Clarify the status of the requested driveway quote before driveway construction can be assessed.
outcomeStatement: I will complete a functional outdoor area with the fence and gate, overkapping, driveway, and carport ground finished.
quote: Great things are done by a series of small things brought together.

statusStatement: Bike hangers were installed and the bikes hung, adding to previously reported TV and speaker mounting. Lighting, electrical finishing, ventilation, audiovisual testing, and future rower space remain unconfirmed or outstanding.

outcomeStatement: I will create a clean, functional Zwift-focused garage gym with completed electrics, ventilation, lighting, TV and sound, and room for a future rower.
quote: Action is the foundational key to all success.

statusStatement: A materials pickup was reported, but the items were unspecified. No installation or finishing task is newly confirmed complete.
whatMattersNow: Confirm that the required finishing materials, including furniture and wall plates, are available.
outcomeStatement: I will finish the downstairs toilet as a fully usable, intentional space with working ventilation, lighting, finished walls, niche, shelf, handwashing furniture, and clean details.
quote: The journey of a thousand miles begins with one step.

statusStatement: Today's food and drink report does not establish a calorie surplus or body-fat setback, and the planned bike ride remains unchecked. Sustained six-hour training weeks and progress toward 12% body fat cannot be assessed without Workouts totals and a new Withings measurement.
whatMattersNow: Use Workouts totals and a new Withings Body Scan measurement to assess training volume and body-fat progress.
outcomeStatement: I will sustain at least six hours of weekly training using Workouts as the source of truth and reduce body fat from about 16% to 12% on my Withings Body Scan.
quote: Take care of your body. It's the only place you have to live.
